'''Tra-Skan-Lor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]], who served as the [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Special Acquisitions Branch]] of the [[Library of the Republic]] some centuries before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. 

Tra-Skan-Lor was intrigued by the recently released ''[[Sayings]]'' of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Uueg Tching]] of [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]] and made his subordinates familarise themselves with the works, causing the ''Sayings'' to become deeply embeded within the culture of the Special Acquisitions Branch for the following centuries.
